actual.descripcion: Jon Moon and his dog Kanto are hot on the heels of some burglary suspects. Jason Baxter rushes to the scene of an accident where the driver was not wearing a seatbelt, only to find that another collision has taken place involving a whole line of vehicles. Finally, Jim Woolerton comes across a VW with a chassis so low that its wheels are catching on its bodywork.
